Rush Blitz: FIELD VIEW : The rusher is leaning forward, visibly anxious to cross the line.
FIELD VIEW : Defense is bringing heavy pre-snap noise right near the 7-yard rush marker.
FIELD VIEW : The rusher is timing your QB's cadence very aggressively.
FIELD VIEW : Rusher has their ears pinned back, pointing directly at the quarterback.
FIELD VIEW : Secondary is creeping up to cover the quick throw while the rusher prepares to sprint.
Man Coverage: FIELD VIEW : Cornerbacks are lined up right in your receivers' faces.
FIELD VIEW : Defenders are locked eyes with their individual assignments.
FIELD VIEW : Defensive backs are shadow-stepping every pre-snap motion step-for-step.
FIELD VIEW : Cornerbacks are playing tight press leverage near the line of scrimmage.
FIELD VIEW : Secondary isn't watching the QB at all; eyes are glued strictly to receiver hip movement.
Zone Coverage: FIELD VIEW : Defensive backfield is spread out evenly across the turf.
FIELD VIEW : Linebackers are keeping their eyes fixed firmly on the QB.
FIELD VIEW : Secondary members are constantly back-pedaling into designated field quadrants.
FIELD VIEW : Defenders are reading receiver paths to pass them off to neighboring teammates.
FIELD VIEW : Defensive backs are playing off-coverage, watching the backfield closely.

FIELD VIEW : Middle of the deep field looks open between two deep defenders.

FIELD VIEW : Cornerbacks are sitting short while safeties gain massive depth on the wings.
FIELD VIEW : Secondary is showing a clear split-safety shell prior to the snap.

FIELD VIEW : Cornerbacks are backing off deep while a safety guards the center.
FIELD VIEW : Defense is showing three deep zone defenders lining up across the secondary.
FIELD VIEW : Outside cornerbacks are dropping off fast to protect against the deep sidelines.
FIELD VIEW : Single-high safety alignment detected in the center field.

FIELD VIEW : Defense has completely backed off—massive cushion given.

FIELD VIEW : Huge underneath gaps visible as defenders retreat way past the first-down marker.
